description: Parity case class (#1640 review F1 round 3): the oracle's is_ratelimit greps only gh's stderr for `secondary rate limit|(http )?429|too many requests`, so the verb decides on the same text — the forge's status line, message and errors[] items — and on nothing else. THE BARE 429 ALTERNATIVE: `(http )?429` matches the digits anywhere in the text, so a primary-quota 403 whose installation id contains 429 stops the oracle's cycle. The verb reproduces that faithfully rather than diverging; retiring the oracle is where it gets fixed, for both.

cycles.note: agents' primary-quota 403 names installation 4290; the cycle stops
